notes: Vitest identities use file > fullName (nested suites separated by >); file exceptions do not exempt tests. File durations cover tests and hooks, excluding module imports. Browser durations sum all reported attempts per spec in the selected run, including retries, excluding gaps between files. Entries were measured in the release or initial local run; failed assertions are not added as successful baseline measurements; removed test titles and .scale.test.ts files are omitted. Remove exceptions as the test-suite diet makes them unnecessary.
